_comment: Cernity NDR — Evidence (Splunk), portable source (native Simple XML rendering is a downstream deploy step — see README.md, 'Rendering'). The pcap/file drilldowns leave the SIEM for the configured evidence gateway: the search computes pcap_href/file_href with isnull guards (null id -> empty, no link) and urlencode (encoded id) via the cernity_ndr_pcap_link/file_link macros, and the drilldown opens that href. observation/flow drilldowns stay in-SIEM. Every pivot is a Splunk CIM field mapping back to siem_pivot.schema.json. Independently authored (§26).
title: Cernity NDR — Evidence

panels.title: Evidence for finding
panels.search: `cernity_ndr_findings` vendor_finding_id="$finding$" | eval pcap_href=if(isnull(vendor_pcap_evidence_id) OR vendor_pcap_evidence_id="","",`cernity_ndr_pcap_link(vendor_pcap_evidence_id)`) | eval file_href=if(isnull(vendor_file_artifact_id) OR vendor_file_artifact_id="","",`cernity_ndr_file_link(vendor_file_artifact_id)`) | table _time, signature_id, dvc, community_id, vendor_observation_id, vendor_pcap_evidence_id, vendor_file_artifact_id, pcap_href, file_href
